title: Add rollback consequence preview
verified: Rollback consequence preview renders under Recovery Workbench for needs-rollback state.
Rollback handle, target resource, base hash, proposed hash and final hash are rendered when audit evidence provides them.
Failed verification and half-committed effect state are visible.
Rollback preview is linked to audit evidence lines.
Rendering recovery.show repeatedly does not append RollbackObserved or mutate run state.
Secret-like rollback summaries are redacted at render level.
risk_notes: Rollback preview is a read-only projection and does not introduce rollback execution commands.
AuditJournal remains the rollback truth source.
RecoveryWorkbench composes RollbackConsequencePreview instead of owning rollback preview logic.
